detail.longDescription: Hi HN, I'm Leon. I built Thrum which runs the coding agents you already use and gives them functionality to work as a team. It started as an open source project late last year but then in May I went crazy and added a ton of features. I was using it every day to build itself and to do everything else I needed to do with agents. As I found limitations in what agents can do, I added features to the product. The basic features were all there in a month or so and then I wrapped it all in the GUI. By this time the agents had sent over 200,000 messages and the whole thing fell over and I then had to spend 3 weeks fixing all of the cludge the agents had built and optimizing everyting. That got the performance to less then 1 second for any command and now the database I use has over 700,000 messages and the performance is still great. Its full cloud infrastructure for your agents but is not cloud based. It connects over git, LAN, Tailscale, and soon SSH. The only data I see is the licensing part. I built it to run fully local so you choose where to spend your tokens. It does everything I need to do any of the projects I work on so I just need to talk to one coordinator and they handle everything. I also created a steward ( like the steward on a ship ) and they watch all of my coordinators and important agenst like brainstormers and act as my steward to keep me up to date and I can tell it what to respond. It bugs me on telegram if I ignore it :) The story: https://thrum.team/blog/launching-thrum-pro.html Give it a try-for free here: https://thrum.team Happy to answer any questions you have here. Leon
